plan.notes: SOURCE: Official UND 2026-2027 Academic Catalog, Biology (BIOL) program PDF, 'Four Year Plan - B.S. with Major in Biology - General Option' (published Total Credits: 120-135). CREDIT-RANGE CONVENTION (honest, no guessing): the catalog publishes credit ranges for many slots (e.g., MATH 146 3-4, BIOL 312 3-4, elective blocks 6-7). Every range is recorded here at the catalog MINIMUM per wave convention; this transcription sums to exactly 120, which equals the published minimum total. Students who take variable-credit options above the minimum (e.g., optional labs, 4-credit MATH 146) will exceed 120. Optional labs (BIOL 332L, 312L, 341L) excluded at minimum; students must still complete 4 upper-level labs per program footnote 1. Organic chemistry may be met via CHEM 341/L + 342/L, CHEM 341/L + BIMD 301, or CHEM 340/L + BIMD 301. Biology electives are any 300/400-level biology courses not used for other requirements. The catalog presents this as 'one possible way' and urges advisor consultation.
